## Description

Context: what we decided and why. One organisation, many locations, like a hospital group with branches in several cities. The organisation is approved once; the owner adds branches inside it with no new Medvya approval, and uploading the branch's registration certificate and tax number is a record the owner is responsible for (same principle as attesting a doctor). The first location is created at onboarding. Overlap: MDV-P7-003 (organisation, facilities and departments administration) is the hospital-scale version; this clinic-level ticket is built first and P7-003 extends it with departments.
What to build. Settings, Locations (exists from MDV-P1-005) gains Add location: name, address, time zone, registration certificate (private Blob) and tax number (GSTIN or TRN format-checked). The location's country must equal the organisation's country (refused otherwise, data stays in country, ADR-003). The audit log records who added it and when. The existing location picker lists the new location. Hours, rooms and holidays are set per location as today. Only an Approved organisation, and only its owner or admin with practice configuration, may add one.
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Infrastructure/FacilityDirectory.cs and PracticeSettings.cs, Medvya.Tenancy.Api/SettingsEndpoints.cs, Facility domain (certificate name, tax number), web/clinic settings locations tab, i18n en, hi, ar, ERD.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an approved organisation, when its owner adds a location with name, address, time zone, certificate and tax number, then it is created, appears in the location picker, and the audit names the owner and time.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a location in another country than the organisation, when it is submitted, then the server refuses it.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a missing certificate, a missing or malformed tax number or time zone, when submitted, then the server refuses with errors under the field announced to screen readers.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a user without practice configuration, or an organisation that is not Approved, when they call the endpoint, then 403.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the new location, when the owner sets hours and rooms, then they apply to that location only.

## Test notes

- Unit: country and tax rules, time zone validation.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL: create, cross-country refusal, audit entry, row-level security isolates tenants.
- Playwright: settings locations add path (journey J1 variant for a second branch).
- Security: server-side authorisation, upload validation, ponytail-review.
- Browser: English and Arabic, axe clean.
